name: Gem Spinners India Limited
summary: Gem Spinners India Ltd. specializes in the production and export of cotton yarn and various grey fabrics. The company's business activities are categorized under its Mill and Trading divisions. Its extensive product range includes combed, carded, and organic cotton yarns, along with knit fabrics and readymade knit garments. This enterprise was established on October 18, 1990, and its primary corporate office is situated in Chennai, India.
